business.description: Privatus Cosmas (online: @_depriver) is a software engineer and digital innovator based in Mbeya, Tanzania. He studied a Diploma in Computer Science at Mbeya University of Science and Technology (MUST). He builds websites, web and mobile apps, business systems, data analysis and multimedia work, and technology for social good. This is his personal website, depriver.tech, with his story and his blog.
